Go to <strong>:residents</strong> and cl: Go to :residents and click + Add Resident. Fill in their name, unit number, ID number, and whether they're an Owner or Tenant, then save. Go to <strong>:fees</strong> and click <: Go to :fees and click + Add Fee. Give it a name, an amount (in ETB), and link it to a Fund — that's the fund payments against this fee will land in. Use the Unpaid link on any fee to see which residents still owe it.
Go to <strong>:payments</strong> and cli: Go to :payments and click + Record Payment. Start typing the resident's name, unit, or ID number in the search box and pick them from the list that appears. A <strong>:fund</strong> is a running po: A :fund is a running pool of money (e.g. "Maintenance", "Reserve") that payments and expenses move in and out of — its balance is always the sum of what's come in minus what's gone out. Go to <strong>:expenses</strong> and cli: Go to :expenses and click + Record Expense. Pick the fund (and, if relevant, the project or employee it relates to) and enter the amount in ETB. Expenses reduce the balance of the fund they're recorded against.
